description: Prospective trial018 replaces only mean-over-four instantaneous ground-load costs by their maximum, relative to completed017. Each instantaneous cost remains the same two-wheel sum of exp(-clamp(Fn,0)/(.20*mg)), weight -1.0. This is max of simultaneous two-wheel sums, not sum of independent wheel maxima, and not a force/contact threshold. Hold original004 parent,600updates/2048envs/24steps/seed42, initial LR synchronization, last-substep LINK-vz and axle reward, all other rewards, motor randomization, reference, controller500/10, physics/contact laws and all original gates. Four actual force reads and one reward read per control window; no additional physics, actor, command, reset or RNG calls. Runtime fixtures and paired final actor verification are still required. Worst-cost aggregation may suppress useful drift or tracking and does not certify continuous contact. No018 learned behavior exists at preparation.
